sources.title: Uber 2025 Form 10-K: Business, Platform Synergies, Revenue Recognition
Uber fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 results, February 4, 2026: segment results, shared costs and metric definitions

input_statements.text: We report Mobility, Delivery and Freight as our operating and reportable segments.
Mobility connects riders with drivers through transportation offerings that include ridesharing and taxis.
Delivery covers restaurant meals and a Grocery & Retail group spanning grocery, convenience and other retail purchases.
Delivery brings together ordering consumers, merchants preparing or selling goods, and couriers delivering the orders.
A white-label offering within Delivery lets restaurants and retailers use delivery services under their own brands.
Freight connects shippers and carriers and earns fees from brokerage, transportation management and related services for shippers.
Our consumer membership provides benefits across rides and Delivery, including grocery and retail orders.
Mobility revenue can come from driver service fees and consumer charges; the applicable arrangement depends on the market.
Shared platform research and development includes mapping, payments technology and internal infrastructure; these support the businesses and are not another reportable segment.
Gross Bookings measures ride and order values plus Freight revenue, including applicable taxes, tolls and fees; driver tips are excluded.
For rides and orders, Gross Bookings is measured before deductions for consumer discounts, refunds, participant earnings and driver incentives.
We report revenue separately from Gross Bookings for Mobility, Delivery and Freight; bookings therefore cannot be relabeled as our revenue.

expected_checks.description: Nest restaurant, grocery/retail and white-label offerings within Delivery.
Distinguish rider, driver, consumer, merchant and courier roles.
Connect Freight to shippers, carriers and shipper-paid services.
Connect one membership across Mobility and Delivery.
Preserve market-dependent fee payers without inventing prices.
Represent mapping, payments and infrastructure as shared capabilities.
Preserve Gross Bookings as a metric with stated inclusions/exclusions.
